messages:
ellie-support: Heads-up — customer 'PayFlow' hitting repeated 400s on our function call endpoint after the model rollout at 11:03 UTC. They report malformed args (strings instead of JSON objects).

sara-cs: Customer says it started immediately after we switched the hosted model to rwd-3b-v2. They included a sample request/response.

ellie-support: ```
REQUEST: POST /v1/generate
body: {
  "input": "Create payment request for $12.50",
  "functions": [ { "name": "create_charge", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "amount": {"type":"number"}, "currency":{"type":"string"} }, "required":["amount","currency"] } } ]
}
RESPONSE (from model):
{"name":"create_charge","arguments":"amount: \"12.5\", currency: \"USD\""}

API ERROR: function schema validation failed: expected object for 'arguments', got string
```

mohit-eng: :eyes: That response looks like the model emitted a human-readable serialization instead of a JSON object. Any chance the system prompt or few-shot examples contain similar inline examples?

ellie-support: Yes — their integration guide included 2 few-shot examples in the system prompt that show `create_charge(amount: 12.5, currency: USD)` (no JSON braces). The customer used those examples in their system message.

alyssa-ml: Likely cause: rwd-3b-v2 tightened instruction-following and is echoing the example formatting. The few-shot examples are shadowing the function schema — the model now prefers the textual example.

tom-se: Repro steps I tried locally: pinned to rwd-3b-v2, send same system prompt with the two examples -> got string-serialized args ~80% of runs. With old model (rwd-3b-v1) it returned proper JSON object.

mohit-eng: Deploy-bot shows the model rollout completed at 11:03 UTC (deploy 2024-06-16T11:02). @alyssa-ml can we add a guard in the gateway to reject string args and auto-parse common patterns for a quick mitigation?

alyssa-ml: Quick mitigations: 1) strip few-shot examples from customer system messages (ask customer) 2) wrap examples in fenced code blocks or explicit JSON examples so the model doesn't mirror the informal syntax 3) enforce function-call-only mode or pass `response_format: json`/schema enforcement at runtime 4) pin them to rwd-3b-v1 as a rollback.

ellie-support: Customer pushed a hotfix to remove examples from system prompt but still seeing a small percentage of failures — probably cached prompts in their frontend. They also reported a spike in request retries which increased token bills.

tom-se: For a platform-side bandaid I can add a lightweight parser that converts common serialized forms like `amount: "12.5", currency: "USD"` into a JSON object before validating. Will add as feature flag for this tenant.

mohit-eng: Longer term we should add model-aware example-sanitization and a pre-validate hook that rejects non-object function arguments with a clear error to the client (and pointer to docs). Also add a test in our rollout gating that checks few-shot examples don't override function signatures.

alyssa-ml: I'll create a small eval that runs customer-like prompts against new model variants to catch this behavior during onboarding.

ellie-support: Action items: 1) sara-cs to confirm customer removed examples / clear frontend cache; 2) tom-se to enable tenant parser flag; 3) mohit-eng + alyssa-ml to add gating and eval. I'll open a support ticket and flag as P1 for this customer (payments failing).

sara-cs: Customer acknowledged and will clear cache now. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Recent deploy: rwd-3b-v2 rolled out to hosted-prod at 2024-06-16T11:02:17Z (rollout-id: r20240616-11).

mohit-eng: Noted — assigning eng-ml to follow up on rollout policy.

ellie-support: Adding logs and sample payloads to the ticket. Will update when customer confirms fix or if we need rollback. :pray:
